name: Dreadful River Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8, 10, 11
  • Processor: 3 GHz Dual Core Prozessor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650, AMD Radeon 7850
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible Sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8, 10, 11
  • Processor: 4 GHz Quad Core Prozessor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950, AMD Radeon R9 290
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible Sound card

short_description: The realm is under attack. The king and his most loyal guards are trying to save the Eternal Crown. Floating down a vast river on a simple raft, you have to fight enemies, improve your gear, find allies and explore mysteries along the shores. Can you turn the tide?
